digest: Investigation of a single failed VPN login for user m.alvarez followed by a successful MFA-confirmed login from the same source IP and device one minute later. Evidence suggests a user mistyped their password, and no malicious activity was observed.

evidence_findings.title: Single Failed VPN Authentication
evidence_findings.subject: m.alvarez
evidence_findings.evidence: Authentication log shows a 'vpn-auth-failure' for user m.alvarez from IP 198.51.100.24 at 08:03Z.
evidence_findings.conclusion: A single failed VPN login attempt occurred for the user.

evidence_findings.title: Successful MFA-Confirmed VPN Login
evidence_findings.subject: m.alvarez
evidence_findings.evidence: Authentication log shows a 'vpn-auth-success' for user m.alvarez from IP 198.51.100.24 at 08:04Z, confirmed by MFA and from a registered device and usual home address.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The user successfully authenticated shortly after the failure, indicating legitimate access.

evidence_findings.title: Absence of Prior Failed Logins
evidence_findings.subject: m.alvarez
evidence_findings.evidence: Notes indicate 'No other failures for this account in the preceding 30 days'.
evidence_findings.conclusion: The single failed login is an isolated incident, further supporting a user error scenario.
